acceptance.description: How this task will be judged done, in a form someone can check: a command and its expected output, or the exact steps and result. Required: a task without it can only be judged by hand, after integration, which is where 2026-10-05's most expensive rework happened.

supersedes_task_id.description: The task this one replaces. The named task leaves the claim queue and keeps a link to its replacement, so 'we changed our minds' stays readable instead of looking like unfinished work.

cross_module.description: Declares that this task shares an interface with another module. Declaring it makes required_contract_ids mandatory in the same row: the most expensive semantic conflict on 2026-10-05 (a reader calling /requests while the backend served /api/applications) overlapped no files at all, so a contract enforced only on file overlap cannot catch it.
